title: F01 General Fitness Knowledge Query Request
description: Public Spring REST request payload for general fitness and exercise technique questions (F01). Personal coaching context is excluded in this iteration.

question.description: The general fitness, training technique, or exercise science question asked by the user.

language.description: Target language for response synthesis (default vi).

exerciseId.description: Optional UUID of an ACTIVE exercise in the catalog if the question is specific to an exercise.

correlationId.description: Optional client tracing ID; never an idempotency key.
